name: Explore Architecture (formerly Inside Design)
what_you_do: A week of hands-on design work. You build models, draw plans, scan and print in 3D, and hear talks. It ends with a show of your work. Choose day, overnight in the dorms, or online.
who_can_apply: Everyone in grades 9 to 12. No prior design courses needed.
pay_detail: 2026 tuition: Blacksburg session $1,250 (materials not included, about $100 estimated); virtual session $250. Needs-based scholarships are offered through the registration form.
duration: One week (2026 Blacksburg session June 21 to 27)
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Dec 1 and closed May 15 or when full. The page says the program is being rebooted; 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the registration links on the program page for the Blacksburg or virtual session. No refunds after the May 15 close. Questions: Chris Pritchett, cpritche@vt.edu.
notes: Page shows 2026 information. Expect registration to open around Dec 1 again, but this is a past pattern and not confirmed. Overnight campers stay in suite-style dorms with an RA.
